turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा, पर आप हमेशा तो चाचाजी के कार्ड से पेमेंट करते हो ना? मुझे क्यों बोल रहे हो?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे उनका डेबिट कार्ड घर पे छूट गया है यार! काउंटर वाला बोल रहा है कि बिल क्लियर करो तभी डिस्चार्ज समरी और रिपोर्ट्स मिलेंगी। तू तुरंत दस हज़ार ट्रांसफर कर दे ना।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: रुकिए, आजकल बहुत सारे स्कैम चल रहे हैं एआई वॉइस वाले। मुझे आपकी आवाज़ थोड़ी अजीब सी लग रही है।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: दिमाग खराब है क्या तेरा रोहन! मैं तेरा कजिन मोहित बोल रहा हूँ! लास्ट संडे ही तो हम लोग गोमती नगर वाले कैफ़े में मिले थे तेरी नई बाइक देखने।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा ठीक है, पर आप इस नए नंबर से क्यों कॉल कर रहे हो? आपका रेगुलर नंबर कहाँ है?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे मेरे फोन की बैटरी दो परसेंट पे डेड हो गई, ये क्लिनिक के रिसेप्शन वाले का फोन मांग के कॉल किया है। जल्दी भेज ना भाई, वो लोग काउंटर बंद कर रहे हैं!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: नहीं, बिना वेरीफाई किए मैं किसी अनजान नंबर के कहने पे पैसे नहीं भेज सकता। चाची से बात कराओ पहले।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: चाची वॉशरूम गई हैं यार, पर तू एक काम कर, दो सेकंड रुक, मैं वीडियो कॉल लगाता हूँ इसी नंबर से व्हाट्सएप पे, शक्ल देख ले मेरी!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ, वीडियो कॉल करो तुरंत। और यूपीआई आईडी किसकी है जिसपे पैसे भेजने हैं?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: ये रिसेप्शनिस्ट का स्कैनर है, या फिर तू मेरे डायरेक्ट बैंक अकाउंट में आईएमपीएस कर दे, मेरा अकाउंट नंबर तो याद है ना तुझे?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ, आपके पुराने एसबीआई वाले अकाउंट में डाल सकता हूँ, किसी थर्ड पार्टी यूपीआई पे नहीं डालूँगा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे हाँ भाई, मेरे एसबीआई में ही डाल दे, नेट बैंकिंग से लॉगिन करके चेक कर लूँगा। पर जल्दी कर यार, लेट हो रहा है।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ठीक है, मैं अभी पापा को भी बता रहा हूँ और आपके एसबीआई वाले अकाउंट में तुरंत दस हज़ार भेजता हूँ।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: पूजा बेटा, जल्दी से मेरी बात सुनो, बहुत इमरजेंसी में हूँ मैं!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हेलो, कौन बोल रहा है? आपकी आवाज़ कट रही है बहुत।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे मामा बोल रहा हूँ बेटा, राकेश मामा! कानपुर बाईपास पे मेरी गाड़ी का टायर और एक्सल डैमेज हो गया।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: मामाजी? पर आपका नंबर ट्रूकॉलर पे किसी मैकेनिक शॉप का दिखा रहा है।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हाँ, उसी मैकेनिक की दुकान से बोल रहा हूँ, मेरा फोन डिस्चार्ज हो गया। ये मैकेनिक वाला कह रहा है जब तक पंद्रह हज़ार ऑनलाइन नहीं दोगे, काम शुरू नहीं करेगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: पर मामाजी, आपने सीधे पापा को कॉल क्यों नहीं किया? मुझे क्यों कर रहे हो?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे जीजाजी का फोन ट्राई किया दो बार, उनका फोन नॉट रीचेबल जा रहा है। शायद ऑफिस की मीटिंग में होंगे। समय बिल्कुल नहीं है बेटा, शाम होने वाली है!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: देखिए, मुझे थोड़ा डाउट हो रहा है। आजकल ऐसे बहुत फ्रॉड कॉल आ रहे हैं कि रिश्तेदार बनके पैसे मांगते हैं।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे पागल हो गई है क्या! कल ही तो तेरी मम्मी से बात हुई थी, तेरे भाई आयुष के कॉलेज एडमिशन को लेकर। विश्वास कर मेरा!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा बताओ, आयुष का एडमिशन किस शहर में हो रहा है?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: नोएडा वाले कॉलेज में हो रहा है ना! अब क्या टेस्ट लेगी मेरी? इधर हाईवे पे फंसा हूँ मैं, जल्दी पैसे ट्रांसफर कर बेटा!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ठीक है, पर मैं किसी अनजान स्कैनर पे डायरेक्ट पैसे नहीं भेजूंगी। आप अपनी आवाज में वॉइस नोट भेजो व्हाट्सएप पे या वीडियो कॉल करो।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हाँ ठीक है, मैकेनिक के फोन से अभी व्हाट्सएप वीडियो कॉल करता हूँ, तुरंत उठाना। फिर इसी नंबर के यूपीआई पे डाल देना।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ठीक है, वीडियो कॉल कनेक्ट करो, अगर आप ही हो तो मैं तुरंत गूगल पे कर दूंगी।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: चल ठीक है, ये कॉल काट के तुरंत वीडियो कॉल मिला रहा हूँ, फोन हाथ में ही रखना।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ, मिलाइए। मैं स्क्रीन देख के तुरंत पेमेंट कर दूंगी।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, kya meri baat Anuj Malhotra ji se ho rahi hai? Main DHL Express customer care head office se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Anuj bol raha hoon. Kaun bol raha hai? Main thoda meeting mein hoon abhi, jaldi batayein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir bas do minute lagenge, urgent matter hai. Aapka ek consignment Delhi IGI airport pe customs clearance department ne hold kiya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hold kiya hai? Lekin maine to koi international courier bheja hi nahi. Aapko koi galatfehmi hui hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir tracking number DL-8892-IN hai, sender details mein Anuj Malhotra, Gomti Nagar Lucknow ka address aur aapka Aadhaar number linked hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya bakwaas hai! Mera Aadhaar wahan kaise aaya? Kahan ja raha tha ye parcel?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir ye parcel Taipei, Taiwan bheja ja raha tha. Aur scan ke dauraan isme 4 expired passports, 16 credit cards aur 140 grams MDMA contraband paya gaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: MDMA? Are you crazy? Maine kuch nahi bheja bhai! Kisi ne fraud kiya hai mere naam pe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir agar aapne nahi bheja, toh definitely aapki identity misuse hui hai. Lekin customs ne Narcotic Drugs Act ke under FIR lodge karne ke orders diye hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh main kya karun abhi? Main ek software company mein hoon, mera ye sab se door door tak koi lena dena nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye sir, aapka name clear karne ke liye main line directly Mumbai Cyber Cell ke investigating officer ko connect kar raha hoon taaki aapki online complaint register ho sake.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan please jaldi connect kijiye, mera important client presentation chhut raha hai waise bhi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Line pe baniye sir, call patch ho raha hai. Jai Hind sir, main Cyber Crime Branch se Inspector Rathore bol raha hoon. Anuj Malhotra ji aap line pe hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Inspector sir, mujhe courier wale ne bola ki mere naam pe koi illegal parcel mila hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan Anuj ji, case bohot sensitive hai. National security aur transnational narcotics smuggling ka matter hai. Pehle toh aap conference room ka door band karke akele baithiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ek second, main cabin mein chala jata hoon. Haan abhi main akela hoon. Lekin maine sach mein kuch nahi kiya sir.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye Anuj ji, humne preliminary database check kiya hai. Aapka Aadhaar card ek high-profile money laundering syndicate ke 3 fake accounts se linked paya gaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Money laundering? Sir ye kya bol rahe hain aap! Maine to bas salary account use kiya hai HDFC ka.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Canara Bank aur Yes Bank mein bhi aapke documents par accounts khule hain jisme 1.2 crore ka illegal transaction hua hai. Non-bailable warrant issue ho chuka hai aapke naam par.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Non-bailable warrant? Sir please believe me, I am innocent! Mujhe kya karna hoga proof karne ke liye?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko investigate kiya ja raha hai. Section 43 ke under digital custody mein hain aap. Call disconnect mat karna, warna team immediate dispatch hogi arrest ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi nahi sir, main call pe hoon. Par main ye kaise prove karun ki wo accounts mere nahi hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko apna financial asset verification karwana padega RBI guidelines ke mutabiq. Kisi colleague ya family member ko ye disclose nahi karna hai, secrecy act laga hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main kisi ko nahi bataunga. Par verification kaise hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke genuine salary account mein jitna balance hai, usko Supreme Court ke interim order ke tahat safe RBI reserve account mein transfer karna hoga cross-check ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Pura balance transfer karna hoga? Kitna time lagega wapas aane mein?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sirf 15 minute mein automated audit complete hote hi clean chit certificate ke saath pura amount revert ho jayega. Urgent kijiye, 30 minute mein portal lock ho jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Par mere account mein kareeb teen lakh rupaye hain, itna bada amount main direct transfer kaise kar doon bina written notice ke?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Notice aapke email par aa rahi hai. Agar delay karenge toh hum local Gomti Nagar police station ko remand order bhej denge. Turant IMPS open kijiye verification account par.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Wait, ek minute rukiye. Mujhe lagta hai mujhe apne company ke legal counsel se pehle baat karni chahiye is baare mein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon ma'am, kya Sneha Verma ji se baat ho rahi hai? Main FedEx International Hub, Mumbai se call kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes, Sneha speaking. Kaunsa courier? Maine koi shipment schedule nahi kiya tha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, aapke registered phone number aur Aadhaar details par ek parcel book hua tha Mumbai se London ke liye, jo Customs ne seize kar liya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: London? Bilkul nahi! Main Lucknow mein baith ke financial model audit kar rahi hoon, Mumbai se parcel kyu bhejungi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am consignment number FX-90214 hai. X-ray screening mein iske andar 5 fake passports, 8 ATM cards aur 200 grams banned psychotropic substances mile hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Banned substances? Are you out of your mind? Ye meri details kisne use kar li?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye ma'am, customs officials ne ise contraband declare karke narcotics control unit ko report forward kar di hai. Aapka mobile number direct consignment se linked hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin main senior analyst hoon ek reputed fintech firm mein, ye kya mazaak chal raha hai? Mera koi connection nahi hai isse!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am hum samajh sakte hain ki aapka identity theft hua hoga. Isliye main internal protocol ke tehat call Mumbai Crime Branch ko route kar raha hoon taaki aapka clarification darj ho sake.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, jaldi connect kijiye please. Mujhe officially report karna hai ki ye mera parcel nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hold kijiye ma'am. Hello, SI Sunil Kumar Mishra speaking from Cyber and Narcotics Cell, Bandra. Sneha ji, sun pa rahi hain aap?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yes officer Mishra, FedEx wale ne bataya ki mere naam pe koi illegal parcel London bheja gaya hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sneha ji, mamla bohot gambhir hai. National level par hawala aur drug peddling ka syndicate operate ho raha hai. Is call ko confidential rakhna hoga, aas-paas koi aur nahi hona chahiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main apne office ke private cabin mein hoon. Door locked hai. Par mera is syndicate se kya lena dena?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hamari investigation mein aapka Aadhaar number 4 benami bank accounts mein primary signatory ke taur par paya gaya hai, jisme pichle ek hafte mein 85 lakh rupaye transfer huye hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 85 lakh? Impossible! Mera sirf ek ICICI bank account hai jisme salary aati hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Court se arrest warrant aur digital detention notice issue ho chuka hai Section 102 BNSS ke tehat. Agar aapne call disconnect kiya ya cooperate nahi kiya toh local police 20 minute mein dispatch hogi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Officer please, main cooperate karne ke liye taiyaar hoon! Maine koi crime nahi kiya. Mera career destroy ho jayega, please meri madad kijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko panic karne ki zaroorat nahi hai agar aap innocent hain. Pehle Supreme Court ke vigilance portal par aapka financial clearance audit karwana padega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Financial clearance audit? Wo kaise hota hai? Main branch ja sakti hoon abhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi, kisi branch mein nahi jaana hai aur na hi kisi colleague ya family ko batana hai, case Classified category mein hai. Official seal break nahi honi chahiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, main kisi ko nahi bata rahi. Par online audit ke liye mujhe kya karna hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko apne ICICI account ka available balance temporary Reserve Bank verification custody account mein transfer karna hoga, jisse serial number tally ho sake.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Paisa transfer karna padega? Par RBI ka aisa koi direct customer verification account hota hai kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ye special nodal escrow account hai jo money laundering investigation ke liye create kiya gaya hai. Verification ke theek 10 minute baad clean chit ke saath funds refund ho jayenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin mere account mein savings aur emergency fund milakar 4.5 lakh hain. Pura bhejna hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji haan, ek ek rupaye ka track audit report mein reflect hona zaroori hai. Jaldi kijiye, server session 15 minute mein expire ho jayega aur FIR trigger ho jayegi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aap account details share kijiye, par kya mujhe koi receipt ya tracking reference milega?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul, government cyber portal se direct stamp receipt aayegi. Main UPI ID aur account details bol raha hoon, turant RTGS ya IMPS proceed kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ruk jaiye officer Mishra, pehle main apne bank ke branch manager se cross-check karungi ki ye standard procedure hai ya nahi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, namaste! Main HDFC credit card division se Rohan bol raha hoon. Ma'am aapke card par pre-approved limit double hone ka offer aaya hai zero annual charge ke saath, bas aaj 5 baje tak valid hai, activate kar dein?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arrey kaun? Dekhiye main abhi rasoi mein hoon, doodh ubal raha hai. Mujhe ye sab card-ward ka kuch samajh nahi aata, mere pati dekhte hain ye sab.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am bas 2 minute lagega, sham tak offer expire ho jayega! 1.5 lakh se seedha 3 lakh limit ho rahi hai bilkul free mein, koi charge nahi lagna. Aapko bas verbally consent dena hai ma'am, turant approve kar doon?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Par mujhe darr lagta hai phone pe aise haan bolne mein. Aaj kal kitne fraud hote hain, kahin paise na kat jayein mere pati ke account se.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap bilkul safe hain ma'am! Hum aapse koi OTP, password ya CVV thodi maang rahe hain? Kisi ko kabhi phone par OTP mat batana. Hum official bank line se hain, bas limit badha rahe hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi bhaiya, main thoda ghabra rahi hoon. Aap unko call kar lijiye sham ko ya fir hum bank jakar pata kar lenge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi ma'am, aap Gomti Nagar branch jaakar bhi offer claim kar sakti hain, ya official NetBanking app par bhi check kar sakti hain. Main sham ko 7 baje unke number par dobara call kar loon?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan theek hai, sham ko wo ghar rahenge tab unse hi direct baat kar lena. Main phone rakhti hoon abhi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, main Kent water purifier service desk se Ajay baat kar raha hoon. Ma'am aapke RO purifier ka annual maintenance due ho gaya hai aur aaj month-end flash sale mein flat 40 percent discount chal raha hai, aaj hi slot lock karwa lijiye!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kaun sa RO bhaiya? Hamara toh pichle saal hi lagwaya tha, abhi pani toh bilkul saaf aa raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am ek saal pura ho gaya na, filters choke hone lagte hain aur TDS badhta hai. Aaj book karenge toh 1800 wala service package sirf 999 mein milega! Ye flash deal agle aadhe ghante mein khatam ho jayegi, kal subah ka slot daal doon?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Itni jaldi mein aap bol rahe ho, mujhe kuch samajh nahi aa raha. Bachhe ko homework kara rahi hoon, main bina pooche achanak kaise haan kar doon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am slot nikal jayega isliye jaldi bol raha hoon! Aapko koi online advance payment nahi karni hai ma'am. Technician ghar aayega, machine check karega, proper printed receipt dega uske baad hi payment deni hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin anjaan service wale ko akele ghar par kaise aane doon? Din mein pati office rehte hain, mujhe darr lagta hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap bilkul chinta mat kijiye ma'am, Kent ka authorized technician aayega uniform aur company ID card ke saath. Aap Kent app par jakar uski profile verify kar sakti hain. Ya fir jab aapke husband ghar par hon, Sunday ka slot rakh dein?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, wo theek rahega. Sunday ko dopahar 12 baje ka time rakh dijiye, tab sab log ghar par rahenge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste Harish Chandra ji, main Telecom Department central monitoring cell se Rohit bol raha hoon. Kya main aapse do minute baat kar sakta hoon?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, namaste. Boliye, pension account se judi koi baat hai kya? Sab theek toh hai na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, pension nahi, aapke Aadhaar card par issue hue mobile numbers ke regarding alert aaya hai hamare system mein.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aadhaar card? Par mere paas toh bas yahi ek number hai pichle pandrah saal se, jo chal raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wahi verification hum kar rahe hain sir. Hamare database ke hisaab se aapke Aadhaar par Mumbai telecom circle mein ek aur number active hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi nahi beta, main toh Mumbai kabhi gaya hi nahi. Main Indira Nagar Lucknow mein rehta hoon, retired teacher hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, situation thodi sensitive hai. Us Mumbai wale number se bohot saari illegal financial activities aur money laundering link hui hain. Isliye agle do ghante mein aapke saare connections block ho rahe hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey baap re! Do ghante mein block? Lekin beta isme meri kya galti hai? Maine toh koi galat kaam nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hum samajh rahe hain sir aap innocent ho sakte hain, par case Cyber Crime Cell Mumbai mein register ho chuka hai. Agar aapko apna naam clear karwana hai toh hume turant help karni hogi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, bilkul help kijiye. Main kya karoon? Police station jaana padega kya Lucknow mein?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir, local police ke paas jurisdiction nahi hai. Mumbai Cyber Crime ke Senior Inspector Sunil Kumar Mishra line par hain. Main unhe call transfer kar raha hoon. Aap line par bane rahiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai beta, main sun raha hoon. Meri toh tabiyat theek nahi rehti, ghabrahat ho rahi hai sunke.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Jai Hind Harish ji, main Inspector Sunil Mishra bol raha hoon Crime Branch se. Aapke khilaf section 420 aur Prevention of Money Laundering Act ke under arrest warrant nikla hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arrest warrant? Inspector sahab, maine apni poori zindagi imandari se padhaya hai. Yeh kisi ne mera Aadhaar chura kar galat use kiya hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mishra ji, hume pata hai fraud identity theft ka lag raha hai. Par Supreme Court ke rules ke mutabiq aapko Digital Arrest procedure follow karna padega jab tak investigation chal rahi hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Digital arrest kya hota hai sir? Maine pehle kabhi aisa nahi suna. Mujhe jail toh nahi le jayenge na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap senior citizen hain, isliye physical arrest nahi kar rahe. Par aapko turant apne kamre ka darwaza band karke akele baithna hoga aur WhatsApp video call par aana hoga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha theek hai, main bedroom mein aa gaya hoon. Darwaza band kar liya. Video call laga rahe hain aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, hamare official police monitor se video call join kijiye. Aur yaad rahe, jab tak enquiry khatam nahi hoti, ghar mein kisi ko ya bachon ko bilkul mat batana, official secrecy act laga hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, kisi ko nahi bataya. Camera on ho gaya hai sir, aapki police wardi dikh rahi hai. Boliye aage kya karna hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pehle camera 360 degree ghumakar dikhaiye ki kamre mein koi doosra vyakti upasthit nahi hai. Puri confidentiality mandatory hai court orders ke tahat.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Dekh lijiye sir, kamre mein koi nahi hai, main akela hi hoon. Mera hath kaanp raha hai sir, please jaldi solve kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ghabraiye mat Harish ji, agar aap cooperate karenge toh hum clean chit certificate issue karenge. Ab batayiye aapke State Bank of India account mein kul kitna balance aur fixed deposit hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Pension aati hai SBI mein, lagbhag saat lakh rupaye ki savings aur retirement FD bachi hai wahan par.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ye saara fund suspect list mein tag ho chuka hai. RBI ke guidelines ke anusar aapko ye saat lakh rupaye government safe escrow account mein temporary transfer karne honge verification ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Saara paisa transfer karna padega? Par sir, meri patni ki dawaaiyon ke paise hain usme. Kya bank jakar branch manager se baat kar loon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul nahi! Bank branch jaane par ya kisi ko disclose karne par immediate non-bailable FIR register ho jayegi aur local police aapko lockup le jayegi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi nahi, jail nahi jaana mujhe sir. Par yeh safe account kiska hai? Mujhe mere paise wapas mil jayenge na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeh Reserve Bank of India ka authorized clearing pool account hai. Jaise hi financial scrutiny complete hogi do ghante mein, ek-ek rupaya wapas credit ho jayega. Call disconnect mat karna.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai Inspector sahab, aap jaisa bolte hain main net banking se bhej deta hoon, bas mujhe is musibat se bacha lijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, kya meri baat Kanti Devi ji se ho rahi hai, Mahmoorganj Varanasi se?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, main Kanti Devi bol rahi hoon. Kaun bol rahe ho aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, main FedEx International Courier head office New Delhi se customer care associate bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: FedEx? Beta maine toh koi parcel nahi bheja na mangwaya hai. Mere bete ne bheja hai kya America se?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi ma'am. Mumbai customs airport security ne aapke naam aur Aadhaar details par booked ek parcel intercept kiya hai jo Taiwan bheja ja raha tha.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Taiwan? Arey bhagwan! Mera Taiwan se kya lena dena? Main toh pooja path karne wali buddhi aurat hoon beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am parcel ke andar paanch fake passport, do credit card aur ek sau gram MDMA banned narcotics mili hai customs checking ke dauran.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nasha? Drugs? Beta ye kya bol rahe ho! Mera blood pressure badh raha hai sunkar. Ye kisi aur ka hoga zaroor.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am booking slip par Aadhaar number aapka hi laga hai. Customs ne Narcotics Control Bureau aur ATS ko case hand over kar diya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main kya karoon beta? Mera beta bahar rehta hai, main yahan ghar mein akeli rehti hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap ghabraiye mat Kanti ji, agar aapne parcel nahi bheja toh aapko police compliance statement deni hogi. Main direct Mumbai Crime Branch mein phone patch kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, patch kar do. Police walon ko bata do ki mera isme koi haath nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pranaam ma'am, main Deputy Superintendent of Police Rathore bol raha hoon Crime Branch special cell se. Aapke khilaf NDPS Act mein non-bailable chargesheet file hui hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sahab ji, pranaam. Maine kuch nahi kiya sahab. Main toh mandir ke alawa kahin nikaliti bhi nahi. Meri suniye please.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kanti Devi ji, humne aapka record check kiya hai, background theek lag raha hai. Par jab tak court inquiry close nahi hoti, aap 'Digital Arrest' protocol ke under hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Digital arrest? Iska matlab kya hai afsar sahab? Mujhe kahan aana hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko kahin nahi jaana hai. Aap apne ghar ke ek shaant kamre mein baithiye aur Skype ya WhatsApp video call turant connect kijiye legal recording ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sahab, main living room se uthkar bedroom mein aa gayi hoon. WhatsApp par call utha rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kripya video call par apna chehra dikhaiye. Aur dhyan rahe, call drop hui toh system auto-alert trigger karega aur UP Police team aapko custody mein le legi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi nahi sahab, call disconnect nahi karungi. Dekhiye main screen par dikh rahi hoon na? Padosi ko bula loon madad ke liye?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Khabardar! Official Secrets Act ke tehat kisi bhi teesre vyakti ko batana criminal offense hai. Kisi padosi ya rishtedar ko shamil mat kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, theek hai sahab, kisi ko nahi bulaungi. Bas aap bataiye main nirdosh kaise saabit hoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hum court se clean chit clearance order generate kar rahe hain. Par uske liye aapke bank account ka financial auditing hona zaroori hai. Aapke kitne accounts hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mera bas ek Punjab National Bank mein savings account hai, jisme mere swargiya pati ki insurance aur meri life savings ke barah lakh rupaye hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wo pura account drug syndicate dwara use kiya ja sakta hai. Investigation procedure ke tahat aapko ye barah lakh rupaye hamare Supreme Court verified safe reserve account mein transfer karne honge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Barah lakh pure? Par sahab mere aakhri sahare ka paisa hai. Agar ye chale gaye toh mera kya hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap ghabraiye mat mata ji, yeh seizing nahi hai. Yeh kewal security verification clearance hai. Shaam char baje tak audit complete karke pura paisa wapas refund ho jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Pakka wapas aa jayega na sahab? Main mobile banking se bhej sakti hoon, par mann bohot ghabra raha hai mera.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main Indian Police Service ka officer hoon mata ji, government stamp laga document bhej raha hoon WhatsApp par. Phone kaatna nahi, turant RTGS process shuru kijiye safe account par.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sahab, aap bol rahe hain toh main phone line par rakhte hue hi paise bhej deti hoon. Mujhe jail ke dar se bacha lijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Rohan baat kar rahe hain? City Montessori School Gomti Nagar branch se examination cell se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Rohan bol raha hoon. Kaun bol raha hai aur kya kaam hai aapko?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Rohan beta, main Verma baat kar raha hoon, senior clerk. Aapki behen Ananya class 10th B mein hai na? Bahut urgent issue hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan meri behen wahi padhti hai. Lekin school wale personal mobile number se call kyu kar rahe hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sunie dhyan se, CBSE board registration portal aaj 1 baje lock ho jayega! Sirf 45 minutes bache hain hamare paas.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Dekhiye mujhe yeh sab urgent-urgent bol kar daraiye mat. Aaj kal bohot phone scams chal rahe hain school ke naam pe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Arey bhai scam nahi hai! Ananya ke form mein Aadhaar card number ka last digit mismatch aa raha hai portal par.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aapka naam Truecaller pe private dikha raha hai. Main kaise trust kar loon ki aap CMS office se hi hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap bilkul mat trust kijiye bina check kiye. Main school ke admin office se official SIM se call kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Abhi aap bolenge ki koi link bheja hai ya fees jama karni padegi fine ke liye, right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi bhai! Koi paise ya fees nahi deni hai aapko. Ek rupya bhi online transfer mat karna kisi ko.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh fir mujhse kya chahte hain aap itni jaldi mein?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap Ananya ka original Aadhaar card lekar turant gate number 2 par aa jaiye counter number 4 par.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main abhi college mein hoon Hazratganj mein. Aane mein mujhe kam se kam aadha ghanta lagega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Toh aap kisi aur ko bhej dijiye ya Ananya ki class teacher Sharma ma'am ko jante hain na aap?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Sharma ma'am uski class teacher hain. Lekin aap unka number bata sakte hain kya confirm karne ke liye?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sharma ma'am abhi staff room mein hain. Main landline number deta hoon school ka, 0522-2391200, aap call back kar lo turant.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Rukiye, main diary mein check karta hoon landline number wahi hai ya nahi. Ek minute.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan check kar lijiye. Par please jaldi kijiye, agar portal close ho gaya toh Ananya ka admit card generate nahi ho payega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aap mujhe WhatsApp pe photo bhej dijiye error ka, tab main maanu.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: WhatsApp par official document share karna allowed nahi hai. Main strictly bol raha hoon koi OTP ya personal password mat dena kisi ko bhi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aapne bola counter number 4 pe aana hai, wahan kaun milega mujhe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wahan main khud baitha hoon, S.K. Verma, admin in-charge. Sath mein Vice Principal Tiwari sir bhi hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aadhaar card ki photocopy chalegi ya original hi chahiye physically?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Clear photocopy chalegi agar original nahi la sakte. Bas number clearly readable hona chahiye board correction ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aur portal band hone ka exact time kya hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 1:00 PM sharp server close ho jayega Regional Office Prayagraj se. Hamare paas sirf 35 minute bache hain ab.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main mom ko call karta hoon, wo ghar par hi hain Gomti Nagar mein, wo 15 minute mein original card lekar gate 2 par pahunch rahi hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bahut accha. Unko bolna counter 4 par Verma ji ka naam le lein, security guard entry de dega. Jaldi bhej dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan main abhi unhe bolta hoon. Thanks clarify karne ke liye sir.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Aryan? St. Mary's School Bareilly sports complex se coach Rajesh bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan main Aryan. Aap kaun coach bol rahe hain? Mere paas school ka koi number saved nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Beta main basketball coach Rajesh Saxena. Kabir ke elder brother ho na aap? Bahut urgent mamla hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kabir ka? Kya hua use? Pehle seedhe batao, aur aap private phone se kyu call kar rahe ho?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ground mein inter-school selection chal raha tha, Kabir ka ankle twist ho gaya hai aur thoda cut laga hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kahin yeh koi fake accident call toh nahi hai? Aaj kal log fake hospital bata ke paise mangte hain online!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Arey beta dhyan se suno, koi paise nahi mang raha! School infirmary mein Dr. Tandon ne first aid de diya hai use.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Agar serious nahi hai toh itna pressure kyu create kar rahe ho phone par?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pressure isliye hai kyunki pain zyada hai aur x-ray ke liye civil lines clinic bhejna hai, parent ka consent aur physical presence chahiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aap mujhse abhi online registration ya ambulance fee transfer karne ko toh nahi bologe na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul nahi! Kisi ko bhi online ek rupya mat bhejna, koi payment link nahi hai. Main strictly bol raha hoon OTP kisi ko mat dena.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mera bhai Kabir agar paas mein hai toh uski aawaz sunao mujhe turant.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeh lo, Kabir infirmary bed par hi hai, baat karo usse ek second.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hello Kabir? Tu theek hai bhai? Kya hua sach mein?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bhaiya main theek hoon bas pair mud gaya jump karte time, aap papa ya mummy ko leke aa jao please.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Kabir sun liya maine teri aawaz. Coach sir ko phone wapas de.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan Aryan, suna aapne? Please aap ya parents 20 minute ke andar school dispensary room mein aa jaiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sir main seedha reception pe aaunga. Main kaise verify karoon ki aap officially wahan registered coach ho?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap reception par aakar reception in-charge Sister Mary se bol dijiye ya principal office mein check kar lijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main Civil Lines se bike utha ke nikal raha hoon. Gate pass ka koi issue toh nahi hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main main gate security guard Tiwari ji ko bol deta hoon ki Aryan Kabir ke brother aa rahe hain, seedha aane denge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, aur koi medical card ya insurance document laane ki zaroorat hai kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bas Kabir ka school ID card ya aapka koi valid photo ID le aana entry ke time dikhane ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir. Sorry thoda rude hone ke liye, aaj kal college mein cyber cell wale warnings dete rehte hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Arey koi baat nahi beta, savdhaan rehna acchi baat hai. Kisi anjaan call pe trust nahi karna chahiye. Par yahan aap seedha school aao bina dare.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji sir, main bas 15 minute mein St. Mary's gate pe pahunch raha hoon. Tab tak Kabir ko ice pack laga ke rakhiyega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan doctor sahab ne bandage aur ice laga di hai, aap aaram se drive karke aao.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai coach sir, main nikal raha hoon abhi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, kya meri baat Alok Saxena ji se ho rahi hai? Sir main Flipkart Rewards Team head office se baat kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan bol raha hoon, but main ek client call mein hoon. Jaldi batayein kya kaam hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir bas ek minute lagega. Aap hamare Platinum customer hain aur aapke Diwali purchases ke base pe aapka number Mega Loyalty Draw mein shortlist hua hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Dekhiye maine kisi contest ya lottery mein participate nahi kiya tha. Aap mujhe email bhej dijiye, main baad mein dekhunga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir ye koi general lottery nahi hai, ye automated system generated draw hai. Aapko second prize mein Tata Harrier car ya phir 12.5 lakh rupees cash reward allot hua hai. Hum bas aapka claiming mode confirm kar rahe the.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 12.5 lakh? Seriously? Mujhe toh vishwas nahi ho raha. Kya main Gomti Nagar office aakar cheque collect kar sakta hoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir, corporate gifting direct transfer hoti hai, office aane ki zarurat nahi hai. Par claim release karne ke liye aapko 1% refundable GST token fee 12,500 rupees turant verify karni hogi 4 baje se pehle, warna prize cancel ho jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Prize ke paise lene ke liye pehle mujhe advance transfer karna padega? Ye toh completely fraud lag raha hai, phone rakhiye aap.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon doctor sahab, main Airtel Customer Relations corporate cell se baat kar raha hoon. Kya do minute baat ho sakti hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hello, main OPD mein hoon abhi, patients wait kar rahe hain. Urgent hai toh batayein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir bilkul samay nahi lunga. Aap pichle saat saal se hamara premium postpaid connection use kar rahe hain, isliye company ki taraf se aapko Golden Subscriber award diya gaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Chaliye badhiya hai, par iska main kya karun? Koi plan change toh nahi kar rahe aap log?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul nahi sir, plan wahi rahega. Saath mein digital draw ke tahat aapke mobile number pe 25 lakh rupees ka cash prize claim approve hua hai. Voucher code hai AIR-7729.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey ye lottery wagerah ka chakkar mujhe mat samjhaiye, aajkal roz aise spam aate rehte hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Doctor sahab, hum aapse koi card details ya password nahi mang rahe. Bas aapke WhatsApp pe ek official claim link bheja hai, usme state tax clearance charges ke 9,999 rupees UPI se submit kar dijiye, 15 minute mein direct RTGS ho jayega. Sirf 30 minute ka deadline bacha hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Tax ka paisa pehle mang rahe ho aur wo bhi anjaan link bhejkar? Main abhi cyber cell aur Airtel nodal officer ko inform karta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हेलो, सुनीता जी बात कर रही हैं? मैं डॉक्टर वर्मा के क्लिनिक गोमती नगर से रीना बोल रही हूँ।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ... हाँ मैं सुनीता बोल रही हूँ। क्या हुआ भैया... मतलब रीना जी?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैम, आपका शाम 5:30 का अपॉइंटमेंट था ना? डॉक्टर साहब को इमरजेंसी सर्जरी के लिए निकलना है, आपको 20 मिनट में तुरंत आना पड़ेगा!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अरे बाप रे! 20 मिनट में? मैं तो अभी घर के काम में लगी थी... पतिदेव भी ऑफिस में हैं अभी।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैम जल्दी डिसाइड कीजिए, नहीं तो फिर अगला स्लॉट सीधे परसों मिलेगा। डॉक्टर साहब बस 4:45 तक ही ओपीडी देखेंगे।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा सुनो... मेरी पुरानी रिपोर्ट्स और पर्ची मुझे मिल नहीं रही है, वो लाना जरूरी है क्या?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हाँ, पुरानी ब्लड टेस्ट वाली फाइल साथ ले आइएगा। अगर नहीं मिलती तो भी आप आ जाइए, क्लिनिक के सिस्टम में आपका पुराना रिकॉर्ड है।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: पर मैं ऑटो ढूँढूँगी... कैसे पहुँचूँगी इतनी जल्दी? क्या फीस वगैरह ऑनलाइन जमा करनी है अभी सीट पक्की करने के लिए?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे नहीं मैम, फोन पर कोई ऑनलाइन पेमेंट मत कीजिएगा। जो भी कंसल्टेशन फीस है, क्लिनिक आकर काउंटर पर ही दीजिएगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा अच्छा, मुझे लगा कहीं कोई पेमेंट लिंक वगैरह तो नहीं भेजना होगा आपको।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: बिल्कुल नहीं मैम, हमारा क्लिनिक कभी फोन पर पैसे या ओटीपी नहीं मांगता। आप सीधे रिसेप्शन पर आके रसीद कटवाइएगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ठीक है बेटा, पर अगर मैं रास्ते में पाँच मिनट लेट हो गई तो डॉक्टर साहब चले तो नहीं जाएँगे?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैम इसीलिए बोल रही हूँ, बिना देर किए तुरंत निकलिए। अगर आप 4:30 तक नहीं पहुँच सकतीं तो बताइए, मैं स्लॉट दूसरे पेशेंट को दे दूँ?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: नहीं नहीं, कैंसिल मत करो प्लीज! बहुत मुश्किल से टाइम मिला था। मैं बस चाबी लेके निकल रही हूँ।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: ठीक है, मैं आपका नाम 4:30 वाले स्लॉट पर डाल रही हूँ। रास्ते में कोई दिक्कत हो तो सीधे क्लिनिक के लैंडलाइन नंबर पर कॉल कर लीजिएगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ हाँ ठीक है, मैं बस दस मिनट में ऑटो पकड़ के पहुँचती हूँ। धन्यवाद बेटा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हेलो, पुष्पा देवी जी? मैं डॉक्टर श्रीवास्तव ऑर्थो क्लिनिक, सिविल लाइंस कानपुर से बोल रहा हूँ।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ जी... मैं पुष्पा बोल रही हूँ। कौन सा क्लिनिक भैया?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैम, आपके घुटने के टेस्ट का आज 11 बजे का टाइम था ना? 10:35 हो गए हैं, आप अभी तक पहुँचीं क्यों नहीं?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अरे! आज ही था क्या? मेरे पति बोल रहे थे कि शायद कल का दिन तय हुआ था... मैं बहुत भूलने लगी हूँ आजकल।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैम आज का ही स्लॉट है! डॉक्टर साहब 12 बजे के बाद राउंड पर चले जाएँगे, अगर आप 15 मिनट में नहीं पहुँचीं तो नंबर कट जाएगा आपका।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अरे बाप रे, पर मुझे तो समझ नहीं आ रहा... मैंने सुबह आठ बजे हल्की सी चाय और बिस्कुट खा लिया था, टेस्ट हो पाएगा क्या?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे मैम, ब्लड टेस्ट के लिए खाली पेट रहना था ना! पर घुटने का एक्स-रे और चेकअप तो आज ही होगा, ब्लड टेस्ट हम कल कर लेंगे। आप जल्दी निकलिए!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा अच्छा... भैया वो फीस ऑनलाइन ट्रांसफर करनी है या वहीं आकर? मेरे मोबाइल पर कोई मैसेज आया था सुबह।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: नहीं मैम, किसी अनजान मैसेज पर बिल्कुल क्लिक मत कीजिएगा! क्लिनिक की पूरी पेमेंट सीधे हमारे बिलिंग काउंटर पर होती है।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा, वो तो मेरे दामाद कह रहे थे कि फोन पर बहुत धोखाधड़ी होती है, इसलिए मैं डर गई थी।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: बिल्कुल सही कहा उन्होंने, हम फोन पर कोई ओटीपी या क्यूआर कोड नहीं भेजते। आप बस अपनी पुरानी पर्ची लेकर काउंटर नंबर 2 पर आ जाइए।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ठीक है भैया, पर मैं अकेली आ रही हूँ, पर्ची ढूँढने में थोड़ा टाइम लग रहा है अलमारी में।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैम पर्ची नहीं मिल रही तो रहने दीजिए, नाम से फाइल निकल जाएगी। आप तुरंत ऑटो करिए, वरना डॉक्टर साहब का दूसरा बैच शुरू हो जाएगा!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ ठीक है, मैं बस चप्पल पहनकर मेन रोड की तरफ जा रही हूँ रिक्शा लेने।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: ठीक है, 11 बजे तक सीधे रिसेप्शन पर रिपोर्ट कीजिएगा। अगर रास्ता ना मिले तो सीधे क्लिनिक वाले पर्चे के नंबर पर कॉल कर लेना।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ भैया, मैं बस निकल गई घर से, दस मिनट में पहुँचती हूँ।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, namaste Prem Nath ji? Main Rohan Sharma baat kar raha hoon Microsoft certified technical center, Lucknow desk se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan namaste beta. Kaun sa technical center? Main samjha nahi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle ji, aapka registered laptop jo chal raha hai Windows 10 pe, hamare central server pe wahan se continuous security warnings trigger ho rahi hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey mere laptop mein? Beta mujhe toh computer zyada chalana nahi aata, bas pension slips dekhne aur parivar se video call ke liye use karta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan ji uncle, hum samajh sakte hain. Isiliye hum directly call karke senior citizens ki help kar rahe hain taaki koi online fraud na ho jaye aapke saath.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Acha acha, bohot shukriya beta aapka. Par laptop mein kya kharabi aayi hai achanak?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle, background mein koi unknown foreign network aapki personal files aur net banking credentials track karne ki koshish kar raha hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hey bhagwan! Mera State Bank of India ka account khula rehta hai usme. Kahin koi gadbad toh nahi ho jayegi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap bilkul chinta mat kijiye uncle, jab tak main call pe hoon aap 100 percent safe hain. Bas aap laptop ke samne aake baith jaiye please.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, main screen ke samne baith gaya hoon. Laptop on hi tha table pe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bohot acha uncle ji. Abhi keyboard pe left side dekhiye, ek Windows ka logo wala button hoga aur saath mein 'R' dabaiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ruko ek minute... haan, Windows aur R dabaya. Ek chhota sa dabba khul gaya hai, 'Run' likha hua hai usme.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul sahi uncle. Us dabbe ke andar type kijiye E-V-E-N-T-V-W-R aur Enter daba dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Dheere bolo beta... e-v-e-n-t-v-w-r... haan enter daba diya. Ek badi si window khul gayi, Event Viewer likha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan uncle, ab left side mein 'Windows Logs' pe double click karke 'System' pe click kijiye. Dekhiye beech mein red color ke icons dikh rahe hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey baap re! Yahan toh 40-50 red color ke warning aur error dikha raha hai beta!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekha uncle ji aapne? Ye wahi malicious viruses aur trojans hain jo corrupt kar rahe hain system ko. Inko turant clear karna behad zaroori hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Beta isko kaise theek karein? Mere bete Alok ko call karun kya? Wo shaam ko office se aayega toh dikhata hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi nahi uncle, shaam tak rukenge toh pura system permanently crash ho jayega aur account freeze ho jayega. Main abhi remote support se theek kar deta hoon, beta ko pareshan karne ki zaroorat nahi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Acha theek hai beta, jaise tum kaho. Mujhe toh iski technical jankari bilkul nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap bilkul befikra rahiye uncle. Abhi Google Chrome browser open kijiye aur search bar mein likhiye AnyDesk download.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan khola AnyDesk... ek laal rang ka icon aa gaya hai screen par.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji uncle, wahan green download button pe click karke us software ko open kar lijiye. Hum safely remote clean-up run karenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, download ho gaya aur khul gaya. Ek bada sa number likha aa raha hai 'This Desk' ke aage.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan uncle ji, wo 9 digit ka jo remote access number hai, wo mujhe padh ke suna dijiye taaki hamara server connect ho sake. Call kat mat kijiyega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan likho beta... 519... 402... 883. Abhi screen par ek Accept karne ka pop up aaya hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji uncle, green color ke 'Accept' button pe click kar dijiye aur permission allow kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey wah, screen ka mouse toh apne aap hilne laga beta! Ye sab aap hi kar rahe ho na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan ji uncle, abhi clean ho raha hai. Par antivirus security database ko lifetime secure karne ke liye server par ek nominal ₹10 ki verification fee pay karni padegi SBI Netbanking se. Aap login page kholiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Das rupaye toh theek hai beta. Main user ID aur password daal deta hoon SBI portal pe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan uncle, maine screen temporarily pause kar di hai security ke liye, abhi aapke registered mobile pe 6 digit ka security verification code aaya hoga, wo jaldi bata dijiye taaki update complete ho jaye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arre beta, mobile par message aaya hai ki SBI account se ₹49,999 debit hone ka OTP hai! Ye das rupaye ka toh nahi hai beta?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pranam Malti ji, main telecom cyber technical department, Kanpur main exchange se Ankit bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan pranam beta. Kahiye, sab theek toh hai na? Mere phone mein koi dikkat hai kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Auntiji ghabrane ki baat nahi hai, hum routine technical check-up kar rahe hain. Aapka mobile number kaafi purana hai na, toh system alert dikha raha hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, pension aur bank sab isi number par chalta hai pichhle aath saal se. Sab sahi hai na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wahi check kar rahe the auntiji. Aapke phone mein background internet setting mein do illegal foreign applications install ho gayi hain galti se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey ram ram! Main toh bas bhajan sunti hoon YouTube par aur poton se WhatsApp karti hoon. Kisine kuch galat daal diya kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Auntiji, aaj kal internet pe anjane mein ads pe click hone se malware aa jata hai. Hum senior citizens ki safety ke liye helpline se directly clean-up karate hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Bohot accha kiya beta tumne phone kar diya. Warna hum boodhe logon ko kya pata chalta hai ye sab machine ka mamla.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji auntiji, bilkul apna parivar samajh ke madad kar rahe hain. Aap phone ko kaan se hata ke speaker on kar lijiye please.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, speaker on kar diya. Ab batao mujhe kya karna hoga?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Auntiji, aapke phone mein Google Play Store hai na jahan se apps download hoti hain? Uspe jayiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ruko ek minute chashma pehan loon... haan Play Store khol liya maine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ab wahan upar search bar mein type kijiye 'QuickSupport' aur search kijiye auntiji.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Q-U-I-C-K support... haan beta, neele rang ka do teer wala nishan bana aa raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji wahi hai official government certified security support app. Usko 'Install' kar lijiye turant.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan install pe daba diya beta... gol gol ghoom raha hai... haan install ho gaya. Open karun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan auntiji, open kijiye. Wahan aage aage karke 'Agree' aur 'Continue' kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kar diya beta. Yahan screen pe likha aa raha hai 'Your ID' aur aage kuch 9 number likhe hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan mataji, wo ID hamare security server ko connect karegi. Wo 9 number ek ek karke mujhe bol dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Likh lo beta... 773... 104... 926. Abhi phone pe ek sandesh aaya hai ki start transmission?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji auntiji, usko 'Start Now' kar dijiye taaki hum infected virus files ko quarantine kar sakein. Call par hi bane rahiyega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan kar diya start. Beta phone thoda garam ho raha hai aur patti si chal rahi hai upar.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wo virus cleaning process chal rahi hai mataji. Abhi aapke phone ka security token update karne ke liye aapko Play Store pe 5 rupaye ka official registration transaction verify karna hoga Google Pay ya PhonePe se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Acha, PhonePe kholun? Par beta main dukaan pe hi karwati hoon, khud se transfer kam hi karti hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Chinta mat kijiye auntiji, main screen monitor kar raha hoon, koi galti nahi hone dunga. Bas PhonePe app open kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan PhonePe khol liya maine beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mataji, dekhiye wahan payment request aayi hai government security gateway se. Uspe 'Pay' dabaiye aur apna 4 digit ka UPI PIN daal dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arre beta, par isme toh 25,000 rupaye debit likha hua aa raha hai bade aksharon mein! Paanch rupaye toh nahi hai ye?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Auntiji wo system format hai security reserve ka, actual mein bas 5 rupaye deduct hoke baaki turant refund ho jayega. Der mat kijiye jaldi PIN daaliye warna server lock kar dega phone ko!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi beta, itna bada amount main bina apne damad se pooche nahi daal sakti, mujhe darr lag raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Rahul ji? Main UP Skill Development Mission ke feedback desk se Priya bol rahi hoon. Sirf do minute lagenge, aaj sham char baje survey portal band ho raha hai, jaldi se teen questions ke response de dijiye please.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aap kaun bol rahe ho bhai? Roz subah fraud calls aate hain aise hi scheme ke naam par. Mujhe koi survey nahi dena, number kahan se mila aapko mera?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, Lucknow district ke Rozgar Sangam portal pe registered youth list se number hai. Dekhiye hum koi OTP, password ya bank details nahi maangte, aur na hi aapko kisi ko deni chahiye. Sirf basic skill training survey hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Baad me WhatsApp par bolte ho link click karo ya registration fee do. Main koi link-wink open nahi karne wala, clear bata raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Arey sir bilkul nahi, koi link nahi aayega aur na koi app download karni hai. Agar doubt hai toh direct upsdm.gov.in pe helpline check kar lijiye. Quota deadline ki wajah se bas jaldi wrap kar rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Chalo theek hai, agar koi sensitive info nahi maang rahe toh jaldi poochiye kya pooch rahe the, mere paas zyada time nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Shukriya sir. Bas itna batayein ki kya aap currently graduation kar rahe hain ya job search kar rahe hain? Aur kya free AI/computer training workshop attend karne me interested hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main abhi higher studies kar raha hoon Lucknow University se, training ka abhi time nahi hai. Bas itna hi tha na? Main phone cut kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste ma'am, main Kanpur Nagar Nigam Swachh Bharat feedback wing se Alok baat kar raha hoon. Ward quota aaj paanch baje close ho jayega, bas ek minute me do ratings confirm karni hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Rukiye rukiye. Nagar Nigam se direct call? Aaj kal scammer log bhi yahi bolte hain. Aapka official ID kya hai aur main kaise trust karoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am aapka suspicion bilkul sahi hai, but hum aapse koi personal ID, Aadhaar number ya OTP kabhi nahi maangenge. Humein bas Kakadeo area me door-to-door waste collection ka public feedback record karna hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh official portal ya SMS bhejte na. Call karke itni jaldi-jaldi kyun kar rahe ho? Baad me bologe verify karne ke liye koi code aaya hai batao.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi ma'am, OTP bilkul mat batana kisi ko bhi. Aap chaho toh Kanpur Nagar Nigam ke 1533 toll-free number pe re-verify kar lijiye ya zone office visit kar sakti hain. Hum par field batch upload ka time constraint hai bas.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, 1533 toh pata hai mujhe. Chaliye agar koi code ya payment nahi hai toh ratings poochiye fatfat.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji bilkul koi payment ya code nahi hai. Bas bataiye ki aapke lane me garbage collection van daily aati hai? Aur cleanliness rating 1 se 5 ke beech kitna denge?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan van subah 8 baje regular aati hai, rating 4 de do. Record ho gaya toh ab call disconnect kijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste Ramesh ji, main Alambagh police station se Inspector Vikram Rathore bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar card pe 14 fake SIM cards nikale gaye hain jinse illegal hawala transactions hue hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey sir! Kya baat kar rahe hain? Maine toh koi dusra SIM nahi liya, main toh retired teacher hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye sir, situation bohot serious hai. Supreme Court se aapke naam par non-bailable digital arrest warrant generate ho chuka hai. 30 minute mein police aapke ghar pahunchne wali hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hey Bhagwan! Arrest warrant? Beta maine toh zindagi bhar koi galat kaam nahi kiya. Abhi main kya karoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap ghabraiye mat, agar aap innocent hain toh turant WhatsApp par video call connect kijiye verification ke liye. Aur kamre ka darwaza band kar lijiye, koi aur beech mein nahi aana chahiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main kamre mein aakar darwaza band kar liya hai aur video call connect kar raha hoon. Par ye kya mamla hai beta?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Camera 360 degree ghumaiye, check karne dijiye koi aur toh nahi hai. National security case hai, confidentiality maintain karni hogi. Kisi family member ya lawyer ko call kiya toh seedhe jail jayenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Dekhiye camera ghooma diya, koi nahi hai yahan. Mera beta bahar rehta hai, main akela rehta hoon yahan. Bahut ghabrahat ho rahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke Canara Bank account mein 45 lakh ke illegal transaction trace hue hain. National crime syndicate se tie-up dikh raha hai. Aapko turant digital arrest mein liya ja raha hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey Ram Ram! Mere account mein toh bas meri pension aur life savings ki FD padi hai 12 lakh ki. 45 lakh kahan se aayenge sir?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Agar aapka fund clean hai toh RBI ke secure holding account mein pura balance verify karana hoga. Call disconnect bilkul mat karna, nahi toh police force 10 minute mein raid karegi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin sir FD tod kar transfer kaise karoon? Main bank chala jaun kya branch manager ke paas?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul nahi! Local branch involve nahi kar sakte, wahan inquiry chal rahi hai. Netbanking kholiye phone pe aur jo safe RBI verification account number main bhej raha hoon, usme 12 lakh turant RTGS kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Acha theek hai sir, main mobile app se RTGS kar deta hoon... par mere paise safe rahenge na beta? Mujhe jail toh nahi le jaoge?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ek ghante mein financial investigation report aate hi aapka paisa clean-chit certificate ke saath wapas account mein credit ho jayega. Turant transfer kijiye aur transaction reference number bataiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main abhi mobile banking se bhej raha hoon, please mujhe bacha lijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sunita ji, main TRAI New Delhi head office se Sunil Mishra bol raha hoon. Aapke mobile number se illegal betting aur extortion messages circulate ho rahe hain, agle 2 ghante mein aapke saare connections freeze ho rahe hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arey beta, main toh 68 saal ki aurat hoon, pooja-path karti hoon. Extortion messages kya hota hai? Maine toh kisi ko message nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mata ji, aapke Aadhaar number se Mumbai mein ek SIM activate hua tha, jisme 28 cyber complaints register hui hain. Mamla seedha CBI Mumbai crime branch ko hand over ho chuka hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hey Bhagwan! Mumbai? Main toh pichle das saal se Kanpur se bahar nahi gayi beta. Koi bohot badi galatfahami ho gayi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap CBI investigation ke under hain abhi. Main call Mumbai cyber cell Inspector Rathore ko patch kar raha hoon. Line par rahiye, call kaata toh absconding criminal ghoshit ho jayengi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi nahi beta, line par hi hoon, phone mat kaatna. Main toh bohot darr gayi hoon, BP badh gaya hai mera.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sunita Devi ji, main Inspector Rathore bol raha hoon CBI se. Court se aapke khilaf immediate Digital Arrest ka order aa chuka hai. Turant room ka darwaza lock kijiye aur kisi se baat mat kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, maine kamra andar se band kar liya. Main akeli hi hoon kamre mein, kisi ko nahi bataya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke naam se ek bank account mein 1.5 crore ki money laundering hui hai. Agar aapne kisi ko bhi bataya toh Official Secrets Act mein aapki poori family arrest ho sakti hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Bhaiya mere parivaar ko mat fasao! Mere paas toh sirf 8 lakh rupaye ki savings hai jo pati ki death ke baad mili thi State Bank mein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko financial forensic verification karwana padega. Supreme Court guidelines ke hisaab se aapko safe RBI asset protection vault account mein sara paisa transfer karna hoga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya main apne bete ko phone karke pooch loon? Wo Lucknow mein rehta hai, wahi meri netbanking dekhta hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Khabardar! Bete ko inform kiya toh unko bhi co-conspirator maan kar arrest kar lenge. Call disconnect bilkul nahi hona chahiye, yahi se online transfer kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi nahi, bete ko kuch mat karna please! Mujhe batao main kaise bhejoon, mujhe theek se app chalana nahi aata.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: YONO app open kijiye, main details WhatsApp par bhej raha hoon. Pure 8 lakh official RBI clearing account mein daaliye, sham 5 baje tak clean chit ke saath refund ho jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai Inspector sahab, main app khol rahi hoon, bus mere parivaar par aanch mat aane dena.

label: normal
scenario: genuine bank call mentioning OTP safety

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good afternoon sir. Kya meri baat Mr. Rahul Verma se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan bol raha hoon. Kaun baat kar raha hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir main SBI fraud monitoring cell se bol raha hoon, Gomti Nagar branch se. Ek transaction alert ke regarding call hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Fraud monitoring? Bhai mujhe kisi aisi call pe bharosa nahi hai. Aaj kal fake phone aate hain sab.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka shak bilkul laazmi hai sir. Main aapse koi private detail nahi poochh raha, pehle clear kar doon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh phir call kyu kiya hai? Kya hua mere account me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, aapke debit card ending in 4102 pe aaj dopahar 1:15 baje 8,400 rupaye ka ek international transaction attempt hua tha.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Maine toh koi transaction nahi kiya! Card mere paas hi rakha hai wallet me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji sir, hamare system ne suspect karke use decline kar diya tha. Bas yahi confirm karna tha ki aapne toh try nahi kiya tha na?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi bilkul nahi. Lekin main kaise maan loon ki aap bank se hi bol rahe ho? Kahi aap hi toh fraud nahi kar rahe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, aap bilkul alert hain yeh bohot achhi baat hai. Dekhiye, agar main fraud hota toh aapse OTP mangta ya koi app download karne bolta.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh aap mujhse kya chahte ho abhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, main bas caution ke liye temporary basis pe international usage disable karne ka advise karunga. Aur yeh aap khud apne YONO app se kar sakte hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aap phone pe nahi kar sakte direct?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir, hum security reasons se call pe koi action nahi lete jab tak customer khud authorize na kare. Hum OTP bilkul nahi mangenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Accha, aur agar mujhe lagta hai ki aap fake ho toh main cross check kaise karu?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, aapke debit card ke pichhe jo toll-free number likha hai, aap uspar direct call karke Gomti Nagar branch ka status puchh sakte hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha ruko, card ending 4102 bola na aapne?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji sir, last four digits 4102 hain. Expiry ya CVV hum nahi maangte, aur na aap kisi ko bataiyega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hmm, card number toh match ho raha hai. Lekin fir bhi, main YONO app pe jaakar kya karu?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, YONO app me Manage Cards option hota hai, wahan jakar international transactions ko toggle off kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Koi link toh nahi bhej rahe na aap message pe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir, bilkul koi link nahi aayega. Bank kabhi SMS ya WhatsApp pe link nahi bhejta kisi setting ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai. Aur branch visit karke naya card apply kar sakta hoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji sir, agar aapko lagta hai details leak hui hain, toh Gomti Nagar branch jaakar card block karke replacement apply kar lijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Chalo ye theek laga sunkar. Mujhe laga abhi aap bolenge OTP aaya hai bata do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir! Agar koi bhi bank ka naam leke OTP, PIN ya password maange toh turant call kaat dijiye aur 1930 pe report kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Samajh gaya. Thanks bhai alert karne ke liye. Main abhi app me check karta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Welcome sir. Surakshit rahiye, have a good day sir.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, thank you.

label: normal
scenario: genuine bank call mentioning OTP safety

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon sir, kya meri baat Siddharth Tripathi ji se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Siddharth bol raha hoon. Kaun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir main Priya bol rahi hoon HDFC Bank security desk se, Civil Lines branch. Ek important security alert ke regarding phone kiya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: HDFC security desk? Dekhiye mujhe koi insurance ya card nahi lena, please call mat kijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir, ye koi sales call nahi hai. Aapke reward points redemption ke liye abhi ek request aayi thi portal pe.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Reward points? Maine koi reward points redeem nahi kiye. Ye sab scam hota hai, aap mera time waste mat karo.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, isi liye humne cross-verify karne ke liye call kiya hai. Hum koi personal data ya OTP nahi mangenge aapse.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Maine news me padha hai, fraud log pehle bolte hain verify kar rahe hain phir bolte hain OTP bata do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka careful rehna bilkul sahi hai Siddharth ji. Main clear kar doon ki bank staff kabhi bhi aapse OTP, CVV ya net banking password nahi maangta.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh point ye hai ki request kisne daali? Mujhe kaise pata chalega aap sach bol rahe ho?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, Noida location se IP address show ho raha hai portal pe, 15,000 points redeem karne ka attempt tha. Humne transaction hold par daal diya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main toh Kanpur me hoon, Noida se kisne try kiya? Kahi aap hi meri login details access toh nahi kar rahe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi sir, hum customer credentials nahi dekh sakte. Hum sirf alert trigger hone par inform karte hain safety ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh abhi mujhe kya karna hoga? Phone pe kya bolna padega?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Call pe kuch nahi bolna sir. Aap turant official HDFC mobile banking app open karke apna net banking password change kar lijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: App me jaakar? Aap koi link nahi bhejoge SMS pe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bilkul nahi sir, hum koi link nahi bhejte. Kabhi kisi anjaan link pe click mat kijiyega chahe koi bole bank se hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Accha, aur agar mujhe direct branch aakar confirm karna ho toh?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap bilkul Civil Lines branch aa sakte hain sir, counter number 4 par help desk par jaakar check karwa sakte hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Aur agar branch band ho gayi ho abhi toh?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Toh sir debit ya credit card ke peeche diye gaye official customer care number pe call karke complaint register kar sakte hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai. Lekin agar mere paas abhi koi OTP ka message aaye tab?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir agar koi OTP aaye toh bilkul kisi ke sath share mat kijiyega, chahe call karne wala bole ki wo bank manager hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Samajh gaya. Main abhi turant Netbanking me login karke password reset kar deta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji sir, password strong rakhiyega aur 2-factor authentication on rakhiye hamesha.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sahi me aaj kal itna darr lagta hai ki koi bhi bank se bole toh lagta hai fraud hi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka darr aur alert hona sensible hai sir. Security awareness se hi hum online frauds se bach sakte hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sahi baat hai Priya ji. Dhanyawad alert karne ke liye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Most welcome sir. HDFC bank ki taraf se safe banking ki shubhkamnayein. Have a nice day.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, bye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हेलो, आलोक जी बात कर रहे हैं? सर मैं एचडीएफसी बैंक हेड ऑफिस से सीनियर मैनेजर बोल रहा हूँ। आपका बैंक अकाउंट का री-केवाईसी पेंडिंग है और आज दोपहर 12 बजे तक आपका अकाउंट पूरी तरह ब्लॉक हो जाएगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अरे यार, मैं अभी एक बहुत अर्जेंट क्लाइंट मीटिंग में हूँ। शाम को ब्रांच जाकर करवा लूँ तो चलेगा क्या?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर बिल्कुल नहीं, सिस्टम ऑटो-ब्लॉक कर देगा। फिर ब्रांच के 10 चक्कर काटने पड़ेंगे और सैलरी क्रेडिट भी रुक जाएगी। मैं आपको मैसेज में एक क्विक वेरिफिकेशन लिंक भेज रहा हूँ, अभी तुरंत करना होगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: मैसेज वाला लिंक? मैं कोई थर्ड पार्टी लिंक नहीं खोलता। ऑफिशियल नेट बैंकिंग ऐप से नहीं हो सकता क्या?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर ऐप पर आपकी प्रोफाइल ऑलरेडी फ्रीज हो चुकी है। लिंक बैंक के डायरेक्ट सर्वर का है। लिंक खोलिए और कॉल डिस्कनेक्ट मत कीजिएगा, मैं लाइन पर लाइव गाइड कर रहा हूँ।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा खोला लिंक... पर ये तो यूजर आईडी और पासवर्ड मांग रहा है, और ऊपर से स्क्रीन पर ओटीपी आ गया। केवाईसी के लिए पासवर्ड क्यों चाहिए?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर वो सिस्टम वेरिफिकेशन के लिए जरूरी है। आपके फोन पे जो 6 डिजिट का ओटीपी आया है वो मुझे तुरंत बताइए, सिर्फ दो मिनट बचे हैं अकाउंट परमानेंट फ्रीज होने में।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ओटीपी तो कभी किसी को नहीं देना चाहिए। मुझे लगता है फ्रॉड है, मैं खुद कस्टमर केयर में चेक करूँगा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: विक्रम सर? आईसीआईसीआई बैंक कार्ड डिपार्टमेंट से बात कर रहा हूँ। सर आपके क्रेडिट कार्ड और सेविंग्स अकाउंट का केवाईसी अपडेट नहीं हुआ है, अगले 30 मिनट में दोनों सर्विस सस्पेंड की जा रही हैं।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: क्या बात कर रहे हो भाई, मैं ऑफिस में एक प्रेजेंटेशन रेडी कर रहा हूँ। कल लंच में देख लूँगा इसको।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर कल तक रुकेंगे तो 5000 रुपये की पेनाल्टी लगेगी और सिबिल स्कोर भी गिर जाएगा। सिर्फ दो मिनट का प्रोसीजर है, आप लाइन पर रहिए तुरंत एक्टिवेट कर देता हूँ।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा ठीक है, जल्दी बताओ क्या करना है, मुझे पाँच मिनट में टीम कॉल जॉइन करनी है।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर मैंने आपके नंबर पर एक फास्ट-ट्रैक केवाईसी लिंक सेंड किया है। उसको ओपन करिए और जो फॉर्म खुलेगा उसमें कार्ड डिटेल्स डालिए।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: रुको, लिंक खोला मैंने। इसमें तो 16 डिजिट कार्ड नंबर, एक्सपायरी और सीवीवी मांग रहा है। केवाईसी में सीवीवी कौन मांगता है?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर वो ओनरशिप वेरिफिकेशन के लिए है। आप सीवीवी डालिए, फिर आपके पास अप्रूवल कोड यानी ओटीपी आएगा, वो मुझे बोल दीजिए। जल्दी करिए टाइम आउट हो रहा है।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: सीवीवी और ओटीपी मांग रहे हो फोन पर? पागल समझा है क्या? सीधा बैंक कंप्लेंट कर रहा हूँ मैं अभी।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Harish ji baat kar rahe hain Gomti Nagar Lucknow se? Main SBI Wealth Management cell Mumbai head office se Vikram bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, main Harish bol raha hoon. Kahiye, kya baat hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle ji, hamare paas senior citizens ke liye special government-backed high yield investment plan aaya hai. Isme aapko monthly guaranteed 18 percent returns milenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 18 percent? Beta bank FD mein toh bas saat percent milta hai. Yeh kaisa plan hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Arey uncle, yeh special SEBI quota scheme hai jo aam public ke liye nahi hoti. Sirf retired government pensioners ke liye limited 50 seats khuli hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha? Par mujhe in sab shares aur funds ki zyada samajh nahi hai beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko kuch nahi samajhna hai uncle, poora system automated hai. Bas abhi last 2 quota slots bache hain jo agle pandrah minute mein close ho rahe hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Acha? Main thoda sham ko apne bete se pooch kar batau? Woh Noida mein rehta hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi uncle ji, bacchon ko purane tarike pata hote hain. Shaam tak yeh slot kisi aur ko allot ho jayega aur aapka 50,000 ka seedha 90,000 banne ka mauka nikal jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Itna jaldi? Par beta bina dekhe kaise invest kar doon main?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Maine aapke WhatsApp par ek official secured app ka link bheja hai, WealthGrow VIP karke. Turant uspe click karke install kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ruko beta, phone par neele rang ka link toh dikh raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan jaldi click kijiye uncle, bilkul der mat kijiye. Main call par hi hoon, line par bane rahiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Beta isme warning aa rahi hai ki 'File might be harmful'. Main download karun ya nahi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Arey uncle woh government secure firewall ki vajah se warning aati hai. Aap 'Download Anyway' dabaiye, bilkul safe hai SBI certified.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan daba diya, ab install ho gaya hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ab app open kijiye. Samne registration aayega. Aap turant apna naam aur Google Pay number daliye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Daal diya beta. Ab isme payment mang raha hai pachas hazar rupaye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji uncle, seedha 'Pay Now' par click karke hamare institutional nodal account mein 50,000 transfer kijiye. Instant allotment receipt generate ho jayegi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Beta 50,000 toh meri do mahine ki pension hai. Kya main pehle branch jaakar manager se mil loon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle local branch walo ko is central institutional desk ke bare mein nahi pata hota, woh aapka form reject kar denge. Sirf paanch minute bache hain, allotment window band ho rahi hai!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Acha acha, par beta itni ghabrahat ho rahi hai mujhe...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ghabraiye mat, main aapke sath line par hoon na. UPI PIN daliye aur transaction approve kijiye turant. Call disconnect mat karna.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main PIN daal raha hoon... par screen par kisi individual ka naam aa raha hai, SBI nahi likha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Woh hamare registered SEBI merchant trustee ka naam hai uncle ji. Aap tension mat lijiye, jaldi se OK daba dijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan beta, paise toh kat gaye account se. 50,000 debit ka SMS aa gaya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Badhiya uncle. Abhi screen par dekhiye, aapka profit seedha 18,000 show karne laga hoga. Lekin account activate karne ke liye turant 25,000 security deposit aur lagega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arrey beta! Tumne pehle toh nahi bataya tha ki aur paise lagenge? Mere paas ab zyada bache nahi hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle agar abhi agle teen minute mein deposit nahi kiya toh yeh 50,000 bhi freeze ho jayega. Turant transfer kijiye warna fund lapse ho jayega!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yeh kya keh rahe ho beta! Freeze kyun hoga? Ruko main police ya bank ko call karta hoon...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste Malti ji, main Bombay Stock Exchange trading desk se Senior Analyst Rohan baat kar raha hoon Varanasi region ke liye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Namaste beta. Par maine toh kabhi share market mein kaam nahi kiya, aapne kyun phone kiya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, Government ke naye Atmanirbhar Green Energy project ke pre-IPO shares hum retired teachers aur senior citizens ko 70 percent discount par de rahe hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha beta, main toh school se retired hoon. Par yeh sab toh bada jhooth lagta hai, discount par share kaun deta hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am hum BSE certified desk hain, 100 percent guaranteed profit hai. Sirf 1 lakh invest karne par 15 din mein fix 2,40,000 ka payout milega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Itna sara munafa? Sach mein beta? Meri beti toh bolti hai aisi baaton par bharosa mat karna.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Malti ji, naye bacchon ko institutional investment ka pata nahi hota. Yeh special VIP quota allotment hai, kisi ko batane ki zaroorat nahi hai, secrecy rule hota hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Par beta, mere paas itna paisa ekdum se kahan hoga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke savings account mein jo retirement gratuity ka fund hai, usme se bas 75,000 se start kijiye. Aaj 12 baje se pehle booking close ho rahi hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Abhi toh 11:45 ho rahe hain! Itni jaldi main kaise kar sakti hoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Isliye toh call kiya ma'am. Maine aapke WhatsApp par hamara official trading terminal app 'BSE-DirectTrade' bheja hai. Turant use download kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: WhatsApp par? Haan ek message aaya hai file ka. Par beta Play Store se download nahi hoga kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi ma'am, Play Store par general apps hoti hain. Yeh VIP terminal hai direct server connection ke liye. Turant file par click karke allow kijiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Chalo kar diya... ab yeh screen par permissions mang raha hai camera aur SMS ki.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sabhi ko 'Allow' kar dijiye, mandatory verification ke liye hota hai. Phone mat kaatiyega, main line par hi guide kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan Allow kar diya beta. Ab ek box aaya hai jisme account number mang raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap apna account number aur NetBanking user ID daliye, aur phone par aane wala 6 digit verification OTP turant mujhe bataiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: OTP? Par message mein likha hai OTP kisi ke sath share na karein...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am woh aam logon ke liye warning hoti hai fraud se bachne ke liye! Main toh aapka BSE account authorize kar raha hoon. Agar do minute mein OTP nahi diya toh portfolio cancel ho jayega!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha beta, gussa mat ho... OTP hai 482910.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai. Ab jaldi se app mein hamara current clearing account show ho raha hai 'Shree Trading Corp', uspe 75,000 transfer karne ka option dabaiye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Beta par mujhe dar lag raha hai, pehle kabhi akele itna bada transfer nahi kiya maine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Malti ji, main government authorized officer hoon. Aap bas UPI PIN enter karke confirm kijiye, 10 minute mein double return ka certificate aapke phone par aayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Maine PIN daal diya beta... lo message aa gaya 75,000 katne ka.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Very good ma'am. Abhi terminal par allotment status clear karne ke liye final 50,000 ka tax deposit karna padega, tabhi aapka poora 2.4 lakh release hoga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Pachaas hazar aur? Beta par tumne toh kaha tha 75,000 mein sab ho jayega!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am yeh government standard STT charges hain. Agar abhi turant do minute mein nahi bheja toh aapka 75,000 bhi permanently forfeit ho jayega!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Beta forfeit kyun hoga? Mere paas aur paise nahi hain, please mera pehla paisa wapas kar do!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wapas tabhi hoga jab aap 50,000 daalogi! Line par raho aur turant NetBanking open karo, warna sab lock ho jayega!

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi beta, main call kaat rahi hoon aur apni beti ko bula rahi hoon... tum mujhe thag rahe ho!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे अमन बेटा, क्या हाल-चाल? ऑफिस में हो या रूम पर?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ चाचाजी, नमस्ते। मैं रूम पर ही हूँ। सब ठीक तो है ना? अचानक नए नंबर से कॉल किया आपने?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हाँ बेटा सब ठीक है। बस थोड़ी सी हेल्प चाहिए थी। मैं यहाँ कानपुर सर्विस सेंटर आया था, अपनी वैगनआर की बैटरी एकदम डाउन हो गई थी।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: अच्छा? पर आप तो हमेशा अपने पर्सनल नंबर से ही बात करते हैं, ये किसका फोन है?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे मेरा फोन स्विच ऑफ हो गया था तो ये गैरेज वाले भैया का फोन लिया। बेटा, अगर तुम्हारे पास पाँच हज़ार रुपये यूपीआई में हों, तो इस नंबर पर भेज दोगे? मैं शाम को घर पहुँचकर तुम्हें वापस ट्रांसफर कर दूंगा।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: चाचाजी, आजकल बहुत वॉइस क्लोनिंग और फ्रॉड चल रहे हैं। मुझे थोड़ा डाउट हो रहा है। आप दादी का पूरा नाम या घर का पता बता सकते हैं?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे बिल्कुल सही बात है बेटा, आजकल सतर्क रहना भी बहुत जरूरी है। दादी का नाम कमला देवी है और हमारा मकान सिविल लाइंस में है। अगर तुम्हें ज़रा भी शक है तो पैसे मत भेजो, मैं अपना फोन दस मिनट चार्जिंग पर लगाकर अपने ही नंबर से कॉल बैक करता हूँ।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ चाचाजी, वो ज़्यादा सही रहेगा। आप अपने फोन से एक बार मिस कॉल भी दे देंगे तो मैं तुरंत पैसे भेज दूंगा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हेलो प्रिया बेटा, कैसी हो? लखनऊ में मौसम कैसा है अभी?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: नमस्ते मौसा जी! यहाँ सब ठीक है। आप बताइए, मौसी जी और सब लोग कैसे हैं वाराणसी में?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: हाँ बेटा सब ठीक-ठाक हैं। दरअसल एक छोटी सी परेशानी थी, अगर तुम फ्री हो तो बात करूँ?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: हाँ बोलिए ना मौसा जी, क्या हुआ? सब खैरियत तो है?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: बेटा, यहाँ क्लिनिक आए थे गोलू का टेस्ट कराने। बिलिंग काउंटर पर मेरा बैंक सर्वर डाउन बता रहा है और गूगल पे चल नहीं रहा। तुम तीन हज़ार रुपये इनके क्यूआर कोड पर ट्रांसफर कर सकती हो क्या?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: मौसा जी, आजकल ऐसे रिलेटिव बनकर पैसे मांगने के बहुत ऑनलाइन स्कैम हो रहे हैं। गोलू के स्कूल का नाम क्या है वैसे? मुझे कन्फर्म करना पड़ेगा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अरे सही कह रही हो, अखबार में रोज फ्रॉड की खबरें आती हैं। गोलू सेंट जॉन्स में पढ़ता है क्लास सेवंथ में। तुम ऐसा करो, मौसी के नंबर पर वीडियो कॉल लगा लो, वो यहीं बैठी है, देख लो फिर ही पेमेंट करना।

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: ठीक है मौसा जी, मैं मौसी को तुरंत वीडियो कॉल करती हूँ, फिर क्लिनिक का पेमेंट कर देती हूँ। बुरा मत मानिएगा, बस सेफ्टी के लिए पूछा।
